purpose: Prospectively define the clean-rebuild evidence and deterministic fingerprints required for the W7 reproducibility audit.
computable_evidence_to_regenerate: W5 formal ontology build and SHACL
W6 PostgreSQL/PostGIS bootstrap, deterministic KG export, SHACL/provenance validation and SQL-SPARQL benchmark
W7-E2 OWL 2 DL and HermiT/JFact logical evaluation
W7-E5 SHACL/data conformance and controlled mutations
W7-E8 held-out generalizability report from frozen first-pass registries

excluded_from_automated_rebuild.W7-E9: Human expert responses are external empirical evidence and must not be synthesized or reconstructed by CI. Only the frozen protocol package is integrity-checked.

acceptance_rules: clean GitHub-hosted runner completes the full computable rebuild from repository sources
two independent ontology builds are byte-identical in canonical N-Triples and manifest
two deterministic KG exports are byte-identical in canonical N-Triples and manifest
ontology and KG fingerprints equal the frozen W5/W6 baselines
all computable W7 evaluators complete successfully under pinned dependencies
environment and dependency versions are captured
all generated evidence files are checksummed and retained as an Actions artifact
boundary: PASS establishes repository-level computational reproducibility in the captured CI environment. It is not independent replication by a third-party research team, does not reproduce human expert evidence, and does not imply empirical validity beyond the evaluated evidence families.
